The association's name is Life With Artificials.

Formal

The purpose of the association is to focus on and place "The 18. world goal - Life with Artificials" on the national-
 and global agenda as well as to create debates about the potentials, dilemmas, and risks in the use and development
 of new technologies. This is achieved via the intersection between technology and art with the purpose to provoke,
 create attention and educate about advantages and disadvantages for humanity and our planet in the use of new technology such as AI, ML, CRISPR, and data collection. The focus is that the integration of "Artificials" in society must happen safely, ethically, and sustainably, for the benefit of humanity and the planet.



The association supports three doctrines: Mind the Future: A new era is coming, the epoch of humanized technology.
Mind the Future: What does the future look like? Do we like what we see otherwise let's change the future in the present.
Mind the Gap: Watch the distance between humans and technologies. Between present and future.

The association's activities take place among others in cooperation and network with artists, relevant stakeholders, private
companies, public agencies, educational institutions, foundations, associations, NGOs and more.

The association can apply for and distribute financial resources with the aim of supporting the association's purpose.
Use of funds

The board makes decisions about the use of funds in accordance with the association's purpose.

The board also decides on possible transfer of the year's result to the association's equity.

Membership

As members of the association, natural and legal persons may be admitted, both domiciled in Denmark and
abroad, who can adhere to the association's purpose.

Membership occurs by written application to the association with indication of name, address, email and phone—

nummer.

The members pay a subscription, which is set for 1 years at a time at the association's ordinary general meeting following a recommendation from the board.


Members of the association have the opportunity to participate in various activities, for which the board establishes
guidelines.

General meeting

Within the limits set by law and these statutes, the general assembly has the highest authority in all matters of the association.


Unless the members decide otherwise, the board calls for one annual ordinary general meeting on
Zealand. Notice of the ordinary general meeting is given by letter or email to the members no later than two
(2) weeks and no earlier than four (4) weeks before the meeting. The ordinary general meeting shall be held each
year no later than five (5) months after the end of the preceding financial year.

The agenda for the ordinary general meeting includes the following items:

© Election of chairman for the general meeting.

* The chairman's report on the association's activities in the preceding financial year.

© Report on and approval of the association's annual report for the preceding financial year, as well as adoption of the subscription fee.


* Any proposals from the board and the association's members.

© Election of chairman of the board and board members

© Election of auditor(s).

The board shall convene an extraordinary general meeting when a board member or a member of
the association hereby requests this. A request from a board member or a member of the association about dis-
holding of extraordinary general meeting must be attached to the agenda for the general meeting. Notice-
notification of an extraordinary general meeting is sent by letter or e-mail to the members as soon as possible after
receipt of request hereof for holding within fourteen (14) days and earliest eight (8) days from the summons-
etc. An extraordinary general meeting can also be convened by a member of the association.

Proposals must, in order to be brought forward at the ordinary general meeting, have been submitted to the board no later than 1
 week before the holding of the ordinary general meeting.

The board consists of 3-6 members, who are elected by the general assembly, cf. however item 6.4. The general assemb-
ly also elects the chairman of the board.

The board members are elected for 2 years at a time and may be re-elected.

The founder of the association, MindFuture ApS, CVR no. 41275677, has at any time the right - but not the obligation - to appoint
 a majority of the members of the board as well as the chairman of the board.

A protocol must be kept of the board meetings, which must be signed by all board members present
 and sent to all members. A board member, director or auditor who
 does not agree with the board's decision has the right to have their views recorded in the protocol.

The board may establish detailed rules regarding the performance of its duties in rules of procedure.

The board keeps a register of the association's members.

Signing authority

The association is signed by the chairman of the board together with a board member or by the entire board
.

Annual report and audit

The association's financial year runs from 1 January to 31 December. The company's first financial year[████] , however, runs from
 the association's establishment to 31 December 2022.

The association's annual report is audited by a state-authorized or registered accountant elected by the general meeting.

Auditor is elected by the ordinary general meeting for one year at a time until the next ordinary general meeting.


Oplesning

The association can only be dissolved when at least 3/4 of the members of the board or at least 2/3 of the association's 
 members at a general meeting submit a proposal to that effect. Such a proposal must, however, in order to be 
 considered, be in the hands of the board no later than six (6) weeks before the general meeting, so that the association's 
 members are informed of it no later than two (2) weeks before the general meeting.

The proposal can only be adopted when at least 3/4 of all members present and represented by proxy
 of the association at two (2) consecutive general meetings, held with at least one
 (1) and at most two (2) months interval, vote in favor.

The association's assets shall be used, after all obligations have been fulfilled, to promote the purposes stated in item 2 according to the general assembly's further decision.
